purpose: Common operating index for all site automation and homepage operations.
mandatory_before_new_work: Record pre-change dry-run evidence for code changes.
Work in one owner scope at a time.

risk_tiers.read: May inspect pages, menus, status, public metadata, and generated artifacts.
risk_tiers.prepare: May fill drafts, build plans, attach local files in dry-run, and save artifacts without final submit.
risk_tiers.approval: May execute only after explicit user approval tied to a prepared artifact.
risk_tiers.blocked: Must not execute automatically. Includes CAPTCHA bypass, payment, credential reveal, and policy evasion.
